scope: Read the full written proof and checker. Checked residue-zero entry, sparse chains, true first and terminal transitions, exact predecessor predicate, growth and width bounds, special R=0/1 cases, and carry-budget failure for every R>=3. Independently replayed in a temporary directory; paths.json.gz and verification.json reproduce byte-for-byte. Pathwise constructed trajectories only; intermediate edges are not claimed to be true reverse-add and no all-input countermap is asserted.
